source: 607 Smell of Food
target: 607 Odor Cibi

source: Lugano’s scalp tingled as he found himself in a surreal encounter with Father Montserrat, bathed in the glow of the crimson moonlight.
target: Cutis capitis Lugani pulsata est, dum se in congressum surrealem cum Patre Montserrat, lumine rubro lunaris immerso, invenit.

source: The sight of the priest, cradling an invisible child in his arms, sent shivers down Lugano’s spine.
target: Aspectus sacerdotis, puerum invisibilem in brachiis tenens, tremores per spinam Lugani excitavit.

source: Is he carrying a child?
target: Portatne puerum?

source: An invisible child?
target: Puerum invisibilem?

source: The so-called Child of God?
target: Puer Dei, ut fertur?

source: Frightened by the association, Lugano tried to quickly shut the door before the owner noticed, as if he had wandered into the wrong room.
target: Territus ob hanc associationem, Lugano celeriter ianuam claudere conatus est antequam dominus animadvertiret, quasi in conclave erratum intravisset.

source: He slipped away without making a sound.
target: Sine strepitu evasit.

source: Suddenly, Father Montserrat’s voice echoed in the air.
target: Repente, vox Patris Montserrat in aere resonavit.

source: “Are you here for prayer?”
target: “Venisne hic ad orationem?”

source: Lugano’s eyes tightened, and like a startled wild cat, he swiftly turned and sprinted towards the staircase.
target: Oculi Lugani contracti sunt, et, ut felis ferus obstupefactus, celeriter se vertit et ad scalam properavit.

source: All he could think about at that moment was his formidable employer!
target: Omne quod illo momento cogitabat, solum erat de formidabili patrono suo!

source: However, what met his eyes was utter darkness.
target: Attamen, quod oculis eius occurrit, erat absoluta obscuritas.

source: No staircase with a wooden floor in sight.
target: Nulla scala cum pavimento ligneo in conspectu erat.

source: In the shadows, clusters of pitch-black weeds, with plump wheat, swayed in eerie silence.
target: In umbris, fasciculi herbarum nigrissimarum, cum tritico robusto, in silentio insolito fluctuant.

source: Lugano’s body tensed, uncertain about the unknown that awaited him in this abyss of darkness.
target: Corpus Lugani contractum est, incertum de ignoto quod in hoc abyssis tenebrarum eum exspectabat.

source: “Why did you run?”
target: “Cur cucurristi?”

source: The weeds parted, revealing Father Montserrat, holding an invisible baby.
target: Herbae se disseverunt, patefacientes Patrem Montserrat, infans invisibilis in brachiis tenens.

source: Behind him, an illusionary, unusually massive oak tree stood tall.
target: Post eum, quercus illusoria, insolite ingens, stabat.

source: Next to the weeds, the oak tree was covered in abnormal growths, forming a chillingly simple and ominous Sacred Emblem of Life.
target: Iuxta herbas, quercus abundabat crescentiis abnormibus, formans Sacrum Emblema Vitae, simplicem sed minaciter ominosum.

source: As Father Montserrat, clad in a brown priest’s uniform, appeared less than three meters away, Lugano swallowed hard, offering a feeble excuse.
target: Cum Patre Montserrat, indutus vestimento sacerdotali fusco, minus quam tribus pedibus apparuisset, Lugano vehementer deglutit, excusationem infirmam praebens.

source: “It’s late. I didn’t want to disturb you.”
target: “Serum est. Noluī te perturbare.”

source: Father Montserrat remained cradling his arms, wearing a faint smile.
target: Patre Montserrat manebat, brachiis suis involutus, subridente molliter.

source: “What did you see?”
target: “Quid vidisti?”

source: Every hair on Lugano’s neck stood on end, and cold sweat broke out on his back.
target: Omnis capillus in collo Lugani erectus est, et frigidus sudor in dorso eius exortus est.

source: Struggling, Lugano pointed at Father Montserrat’s empty embrace, asking with difficulty, “Why are you doing this?”
target: Luctans, Lugano digitum ad Patrem Montserrat, eius vacuam amplexum demonstrans, difficulter quaesivit: “Cur hoc facis?”

source: Father Montserrat responded with a significant tone, “We’re all Mother’s children.”
target: Pater Montserrat respondit graviter: “Omnes sumus filii Matris.”

source: Lugano didn’t dare to delve further and nodded repeatedly.
target: Lugano non ausus est ultra quaerere et saepius annuit.

source: “Yes, yes, yes. We’re all Mother’s children.”
target: “Ita, ita, ita. Omnes sumus filii Matris.”

source: Father Montserrat didn’t allow him to navigate through with platitudes.
target: Pater Montserrat eum non sinit ulterius per verba vana iterari.

source: He deliberately added,
target: Proposito addidit:

source: “The child of the Great Mother.”
target: “Puer Magnae Matris.”

source: Great Mother… Although Lugano had anticipated this answer, his heart almost skipped a beat, and his mind went blank upon hearing it.
target: Magna Mater… Quamquam Lugano hanc responsionem antevidit, cor eius paene exstoluit, et mens eius vacua facta est, audiente eam.

source: Seeing that Father Montserrat had made it explicit, Lugano had no choice but to inquire,
target: Videns Patrem Montserrat hoc patefecisse, Lugano non habuit aliud nisi interrogare:

source: “Aren’t… aren’t you a follower of Earth Mother?”
target: “Nonne… non es sectator Matris Terrae?”

source: Father Montserrat felt no remorse about betraying the Church of Earth Mother.
target: Pater Montserrat nullum dolorem habuit de proditione Ecclesiae Matris Terrae.

source: He maintained a warm smile and explained, “Earth Mother is a facet of the Great Mother, a projection.”
target: Eius subrisum calidum servavit et explanavit: “Mater Terra est pars Magnae Matris, quasi imago.”

source: In this role, she watches over the lands of betrayal and the children who have strayed from the Mother’s embrace.
target: In hoc munere, illa terras proditionis et filios qui ab amplexu Matris erraverunt, curat.

source: Gulp… Lugano instinctively swallowed, uncertain about how to counter Father Montserrat.
target: Gulp… Lugano instinctuose deglutit, incertus quomodo Patrem Montserrat repellere posset.

source: Having joined the Church of Earth Mother just a day ago and attended only two sermons, he lacked the profound theological knowledge to challenge such heretics.
target: Quoniam die uno abhinc Ecclesiam Matris Terrae adiunxerat et solum duas praedicacula audiverat, ei defuere profundae scientiae theologicae ad talia haereticos oppugnandos.

source: He could, of course, outright deny it.
target: Scilicet, id plane negare poterat.

source: After all, Montserrat’s explanation sounded ominous.
target: Postremo, explanatio Montserrat ominose sonabat.

source: If the priest’s words were true, with the Earth Mother Church’s resources and factions, the so-called Child of God should have already been born in the real world, and the Great Mother would have returned.
target: Si verba sacerdotis vera essent, cum opibus et factionibus Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, puer Dei, ut fertur, iam in mundo reali natus esse debuisset, et Magna Mater redivisset.

source: Yet, that hadn’t happened.
target: At id non evenit.

source: The current scene and the invisible pressure silenced Lugano, refraining from outright denial.
target: Scaena praesentis atque pressura invisibilis Lugano silentium obtinuerunt, et eum ab aperta negatione abstinuerunt.

source: What if he enraged Father Montserrat completely?
target: Quid si Patrem Montserrat omnino ad iram excitaverit?

source: Father Montserrat continued, “All creatures in this world are the children of the Great Mother.
target: Pater Montserrat continuavit: “Omnes creaturae huius mundi sunt filii Magnae Matris.

source: Some were conceived by her, some are descendants of these deities, and some, like you and me, were directly transformed from the flesh and blood of the Great Mother. We share the strongest connection with her!”
target: Aliqui a ea concepti sunt, alii ex his deis descendunt, et quidam, ut tu et ego, directe ex carne et sanguine Magnae Matris transformati sumus. Nobis fortissimum vinculum cum ea est!

source: Internally, Lugano couldn’t help but retort, I was born by my mother, not transformed from the flesh and blood of the Great Mother… However, his smile remained, more grimacing than joyous.
target: Intus, Lugano non potuit non remittere: “Ego a matre natus sum, non ex carne et sanguine Magnae Matris transformatus.” Attamen, risus eius permanuit, magis contritus quam laetus.

source: “Don’t you find the Great Mother’s believers sinister and terrifying?”
target: “Nonne existimas fideles Magnae Matris sinistros et terribiles esse?”

source: Father Montserrat smiled and reassured, “There’s no need to fear the return of the Great Mother. How can a mother hate her child?
target: Pater Montserrat subridens et consolans respondit: “Non est causa timendi reditum Magnae Matris. Quomodo potest mater filium suum oderi?”

source: You might not know, but there are many worlds beyond ours. The creatures in those places flourish under the watch of the Great Mother, constantly reproducing and growing. I’ve never heard of any species being eradicated. Instead, their numbers are increasing.
target: Fortasse nescis, sed multi orbi extra nostros sunt. Creaturae in illis locis sub custodia Magnae Matris florent, constanter generantes et crescientes. Numquam audivi ullam speciem eradicatam esse. Immo, numeri eorum augentur.

source: Moreover, it’s the Great Mother who granted us life. It’s her prerogative to reclaim the life she bestowed upon us. We should cooperate willingly.
target: Praeterea, Magna Mater est quae nobis vitam dedit. Eius est prerogativa vitam, quam nobis dedit, recipiendi. Cooperemus libenter.

source: Cooperate my rear end, you son of a sow! Lugano wasn’t bewitched.
target: Coopera, podex meus, filius scrofae! Lugano non erat incantatus.

source: Suddenly, he drew his concealed revolver and fired two shots at Father Montserrat.
target: Repente, revolverum occultum eduxit et duo ictus in Patrem Montserrat iecit.

source: Without confirming the effectiveness of the shots, he swiftly turned and sprinted toward the dark expanse filled with black weeds.
target: Nihil ictuum efficacitatem comprobans, celeriter se vertit et ad vastum spatium obscurum, herbis nigrissimis repletum, properavit.

source: “Waaa!”
target: “Waaa!”

source: Abruptly, Lugano heard an almost ethereal cry of an infant.
target: Subito, Lugano audivit clamorem infantuli paene aetherium.

source: It was exactly the same as the sounds he had heard several times before.
target: Idem erat prorsus ac soni quos ante aliquoties audiverat.

source: Lugano’s expression froze, and his pace slowed as he ran.
target: Vultus Lugani stetit, et celeritas eius remissa est dum currebat.

source: His eyes gradually filled with emptiness, and he turned around.
target: Oculi eius paulatim vacuo impleti sunt, et se vertit.

source: Step by step, he approached Father Montserrat, who was cradling an invisible baby, and the illusory, colossal oak tree.
target: Gradatim accessit ad Patrem Montserrat, qui puerum invisibilem in brachiis tenens, et ad quercum illusoriam ingentem.

source: “That’s our mother…
target: Haec est mater nostra…

source: The mother who gave us life…
target: Mater quae nobis vitam dedit…

source: She’s willing to accept anyone who repents, every child who returns home…
target: Ea parata est accipere quemvis paenitentem, omne puerum qui domum redeat…

source: If she wants to take back the life she bestowed upon us, then let her. She has the prerogative to reclaim what she gave…
target: Si vult vitam, quam nobis dedit, revocare, tunc fiat. Illa habet praeeminentiam ad recipiendum quod dedit…

source: Listening to Father Montserrat’s abnormally ethereal yet seemingly close voice, Lugano gradually developed a strong and heartfelt acceptance.
target: Audientem vocem Patris Montserrat, quae anomale aetheria sed prope apparuit, Lugano paulatim acceptationem firmam et sincere ex corde evolvit.

source: “Yes, that’s my mother…
target: “Ita, haec est mater mea…

source: Why would she harm me?
target: Cur mihi noceret?

source: She can take back what she had given…
target: Ea potest recipere id quod dedit…

source: Lugano walked faster and faster until he stood beside Father Montserrat.
target: Lugano celerius et celerius ambulavit, donec iuxta Patrem Montserrat se constituit.

source: Instantly, he felt warmth and relief. It was the scent of a mother’s embrace.
target: Statim, sensit calorem et levationem; erat odor amplexus matris.

source: Gradually, he experienced an indescribable moist sensation, as if a kitten were being licked by a female cat.
target: Paulatim, sensit sensum umidum ineffabilem, quasi catillus a femina feli lingebatur.

source: How comforting… Lugano half-closed his eyes.
target: Quam solacum… Lugano semiter clausit oculos suos.

source: At that moment, he heard his mother’s favorite nursery rhyme
target: Illo momento, audivit canticum infans, quod mater eius maxime amabat

source: —from behind him.
target: —ex tergo eius.

source: Why is Mom behind me? Shouldn’t she be in front? Lugano wondered vaguely.
target: Cur mater mea post me est? Nonne debet esse ante me? Lugano vago animo quaerebat.

source: Then, he heard his mother shouting behind him, “Don’t go over!
target: Tum audivit matrem suam ex tergo clamantem: “Noli transire!”

source: “Don’t move forward!
target: “Noli progredi!”

source: “Danger!”
target: “Periculum!”

source: Don’t go over… Don’t move forward… Danger… Lugano shuddered, his vacant eyes regaining a certain vigor.
target: Noli transire… Noli progredi… Periculum… Lugano contremuit, oculi eius inania aliquam vim recipuerunt.

source: He saw where he was—the illusory colossal oak tree and moist, warm, squirming flesh petals sprouting from it. Half of his body was already enveloped in the flesh petals, slowly pulling inward.
target: Vidit ubi esset: quercus illusoria ingentis magnitudinis et petala carnis umida, calida, et contorta, quae ex ea oriebantur. Dimidium corporis eius iam in petalis carnis involutum erat, quae lente intus trahuntur.

source: This was the motherly embrace he had just experienced.
target: Hoc erat amplexus maternum, quem modo expertus erat.

source: Lugano’s pupils dilated, and a chill ran down his spine, causing his hair to stand on end.
target: Pupillae Lugani dilatatae sunt, et frigus per spinam eius cucurrit, faciens capillos eius erectos.

source: He exerted strength against the viscous liquid-covered flesh with both hands, swiftly pulling away.
target: Ambabus manibus vim imponebat adversus carnem liquido viscoso involutam, celeriter aufugiens.

source: Father Montserrat, cradling an invisible baby, appeared beside Lugano, wearing a warm smile.
target: Pater Montserrat, infante invisibili in brachiis eius portaretur, apparuit iuxta Lugano, subridente calido.

source: “Return. Return to the Mother’s embrace and revert to our original form.”
target: “Redi. Redi ad amplexum Matris et ad formam nostram primigeniam revertere.”

source: Despair gripped Lugano.
target: Desperatio Lugani premebat.

source: He wanted to confront the priest, but sadly, having consumed two potions—Planter and Doctor—he realized that, apart from enhanced strength and proficiency with farming tools and a scalpel, he lacked Beyonder powers directly applicable in combat. These powers included predicting the weather, identifying and nurturing seeds, treating ailments, healing wounds, stitching up souls, bestowing life, or possessing outstanding surgical abilities.
target: Volebat sacerdotem oppugnare, sed, pro dolor, postquam duas pocula—Planter et Doctor—consumaverat, intellexit se, praeter vim amplificatam et peritiam in agricolis instrumentis atque scalplo, potentias Beyonder, quae directe in proelio adhiberentur, deficere.

source: In the past, Lugano had relied on the combat techniques and marksmanship learned as a bounty hunter to match a Planter’s strength and firearms.
target: Olim, Lugano in technicis proelii et in arte sclopetaria, quae didicerat ut venator praemiis, confidebat, ut vim Planterae et armorum ignifera aequaret.

source: Nevertheless, not resisting at a moment like this meant certain death.
target: Attamen, in tali momento non resistere mortem certam significabat.

source: Lugano, an adventurer with a history of killing, faced immense fear as he fired at Father Montserrat and drew a sharp scalpel.
target: Lugano, adventurer cum caedes memoria relicta, ingentem metum sensit dum Patrem Montserrat iecit et acutum scalpellum extraxit.

source: In Lumian’s first-class cabin suite, Lumian, still engrossed in the Dutanese textbook under the kerosene wall lamp, heard a knock on the door.
target: In cubiculo primae classe Lumiani, Lumian, adhuc in Dutanensi lectione sub lampada parietali kerosene occupatus, pulsationem ad ianuam audivit.

source: Perplexed, he stood up, opened the door, and found Ludwig.
target: Perplexus, surrexit, ianuam aperuit, et Ludwig invenit.

source: Ludwig, clad in grayish-white checkered pajamas top and pants, spoke gravely,
target: Ludwig, indutus in pyjama quadricolor cinereus-albidus, graviter locutus est:

source: “Lugano has encountered an accident. Hurry up and save him.”
target: “Lugano casum passus est. Festina et eum salva.”

source: An accident?
target: Casus?

source: Lumian arched his eyebrows.
target: Lumian supercilia arcuit.

source: Knowing that Lugano could still hear the baby’s cries, Lumian had discreetly heightened his surveillance and attention on the servant, including just now.
target: Scientes Lugano adhuc infantuli clamores audire posse, Lumian caute vigilantiam et attentionem in servo auxit, etiam modo.

source: But how could an accident occur when Lugano had entered the Earth Mother Church’s prayer room?
target: Sed quomodo casus evenire poterat, cum Lugano in conclave orationis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae intravisset?

source: Ludwig continued, “I couldn’t sense his scent after he entered the prayer room.”
target: Ludwig continuavit: “Non potui odorem eius sentire postquam in conclave orationis intravit.”

source: “What scent?”
target: “Quid odorem?”

source: Lumian inquired casually, already forming a vague suspicion.
target: Lumian leviter inquisivit, iam suspicionem vagam formans.

source: Ludwig responded nonchalantly, “The smell of food.”
target: Ludwig respondit nonchalans: “Odor cibi.”

source: Lumian stretched his neck and wrists, regarding Ludwig thoughtfully.
target: Lumian collum et carpus extendit, Ludwig attente intuens.

source: “You deliberately sniffed his scent.”
target: “Tu deliberate eius odorem inspiravisti.”

source: Ludwig’s chubby cheeks displayed an expression that said, “What’s so odd about that?”
target: Ludwig, cui gulae erant pingues, vultum exprimit, qui dicebat: “Quid in hoc tam mirum est?”

source: “If he perishes and you’re busy elsewhere, who will assist me in gathering food?”
target: “Si ille perit et tu alio occupatus es, quis mihi in cibi colligendo auxiliabitur?”

source: “That’s a valid point.”
target: “Id est argumentum validum.”

source: Lumian grinned.
target: Lumian subridens.

source: In the darkness, enveloped by black weeds, Lugano’s scalpel sliced through the air as he attempted to strike Father Montserrat.
target: In tenebris, circumdatum herbis nigrissimis, scalpellum Lugani per aerem secabat, conans Patrem Montserrat ferire.

source: “Waaa!”
target: “Waaa!”

source: The baby’s cries echoed once more, leaving Lugano in a momentary daze, teetering on the edge of losing control.
target: Clamores infantis iterum resonaverunt, relinquentes Lugano in statu momentaneo attoniti, vacillantem in limine moderationis.

source: With the invisible baby cradled in his arms, Montserrat manifested on the colossal illusory oak tree and smiled down at Lugano.
target: Cum infans invisibilis in brachiis eius portaretur, Montserrat in quercu illusorio ingenti apparuit atque deorsum ad Lugano subridens intuitus est.

source: “Don’t resist. We originated from the Mother, and we shall return to her.”
target: “Noli resistere. Ex Matre originati sumus, et ad eam reverterimus.”

source: Just as the priest, with clear eyes and a warm smile, finished speaking, a knock on the door reverberated in the seemingly endless darkness, echoing among the weeds with abundant wheat.
target: Simul, cum sacerdos, oculis perspicuis et subridente calido, sermonem finivit, pulsatio ad ianuam in obscuritate quasi infinita resonavit, inter herbas cum trigo abundantissimo echo resonans.

source: Upon hearing the polite knock on the door, Lugano had an inexplicable thought.
target: Audito urbanitate pulsatione ianuae, Lugano cogitationem inexplicablem habuit.

source: How polite—to knock at the door in such a situation…
target: Quam urbanum—ianuam pulsare in tali condicione…
